About this program
Investigate the solar system and distant galaxies.
Take advantage of NAU's state-of-the-art resources and nearby geologic settings to facilitate your terrestrial and analog planetary science investigations. NAU partners with Lowell Observatory, the US Geological Survey, Astrogeology Science Center, the US Naval Observatory, the Naval Research Laboratory, the Discovery Channel Telescope, the Naval Precision Optical Interferometer, and more. Courses focus on advanced topics in astronomy and planetary science, such as big data and remote sensing, and others.
